findings.issue: Publication pending state does not lock the editor. Edits made during publication can be discarded while the older saved version becomes public.
findings.reproduction: Open a saved draft, click Publish, then change its title while publication is pending. RequestCard tracks pending locally; RequestForm remains enabled. Successful publication calls newDraft(), discarding the new edit.
findings.recommendation: Lift publication pending state into ClientRequests and disable the editor until publication finishes.
